name: Dave Strider
source:
A friend of Rose, John, and Jade. Dave lives with his older brother in an apartment in Texas. He is befriended in Volume 3 of Pesterquest.

Dave is dedicated to the art of irony and works to maintain the image of himself as a "cool kid".
